items.source_text: 限定一次！仅含力量类型的SSR支援卡！
items.current_text: Giới hạn 1 lần! Chỉ gồm Support Card SSR loại Power!

community_terms.basis: Common player-facing Uma Musume term; preserve Support Card in English.

Common EN-version Power stat label. The zh-CN alias 力量 is ambiguous in ordinary prose and can also occur inside proper names such as 莱茵力量 (Rhein Kraft); known non-stat compounds, names, descriptive titles, and narrative/metaphorical phrases are explicitly excluded so physical or emotional strength is not normalized to the stat label.

source_bridge_terms.note: 支援卡 is the zh-CN bridge for the player-facing Support Card term. Preserve Support Card instead of translating it literally into Vietnamese.

concepts: Disambiguate ordinary physical strength from the Power stat
Distinguish stat Power from ordinary prose strength
Generic narrative power versus Power stat
Power stat alias must exclude generic descriptive phrase 不可思议力量
Power stat alias must not match ordinary metaphorical prose
Power stat rule must not match ordinary strength or 力量石 resource-name prose
